architecture.mechanism: Attention mechanisms applied to one-dimensional convolutional neural networks for rolling bearing fault classification
architecture.intervention: Deploy a 1D-CNN with ECA attention mechanism on high-frequency vibration and acoustic emission sensors integrated into the engine block during manufacturing, using real-time inference to dynamically control oil pump pressure and fuel injection timing at the hardware level to maintain optimal hydrodynamic lubrication film thickness in the crankshaft bearing assembly under all operating conditions.
architecture.expected_effect: Elimination of the root cause of catastrophic bearing failure by ensuring continuous adequate lubrication film thickness through active hardware-level control, preventing metal-to-metal contact and thermal degradation of the bearing surfaces without relying solely on post-failure ECU warning calibrations.
architecture.falsification_test: Run a full-load engine dynamometer endurance test with intentionally degraded oil viscosity; if the attention-enhanced 1D-CNN control system fails to prevent measurable bearing surface wear exceeding baseline specifications within 500 hours, the intervention is falsified.
